title: Placing Actors 🧱
description: Learn every way to bring objects into your world and position them.

slides.title: Place Actors Panel 🛠️
slides.content:
# Your Object Library

The **Place Actors** panel (left side of editor) categorises everything you can add:

* **Basic** – cube, sphere, cylinder, plane
* **Lights** – point, spot, directional, sky
* **Visual Effects** – fog, particles
* **Volumes** – triggers, blocking volumes
* **All Classes** – every Actor type in the engine

Drag any item into the viewport or click and then click in the viewport. Simple!

*Analogy:* It’s a **warehouse catalogue** – you pick an item, then tell the system where to drop it.

quizData.question: You can only place Actors by dragging from the Place Actors panel.
quizData.explanation: You can also drag assets from the Content Browser into the viewport, or right‑click in the viewport and select 'Place Actor'.

slides.title: Drag from Content Browser 📁➡️🌍
slides.content:
## Instant Placement

Any asset in the Content Browser can be dragged directly into the viewport:
* Static Meshes → become Static Mesh Actors
* Materials → apply to a surface if you drag onto it
* Blueprint Classes → become Blueprint Actors
* Sound Cues → nothing visible, but you can place them (they create an Ambient Sound Actor)

This is often faster than the Place Actors panel because you're working directly with your assets.

slides.title: Snapping & Alignment 📏
slides.content:
## Precision Without the Pain

Snapping helps you align objects perfectly:

* **Surface Snapping** – drag an object near a surface and it sticks. Enable/disable with **Alt key**.
* **Grid Snapping** – objects move in fixed increments (e.g., every 10 units). Toggle with the grid icon or set value in toolbar.
* **Angle Snapping** – rotation locks to increments (e.g., every 15°).
* **Scale Snapping** – scale in fixed steps.

In the viewport toolbar, you’ll see icons for each. Right‑click them to set increment values.

**Ctrl+End** snaps selected objects to the ground.

quizData.question: Press _____+End to snap selected actors to the ground.
quizData.explanation: Ctrl+End aligns the selected actor's lowest point with the surface below it.

slides.title: Duplication Magic ✨
slides.content:
## Copy, Paste, Duplicate

Instead of placing from scratch, reuse existing actors:

* **Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V** – copy and paste (keeps offset)
* **Ctrl+D** – duplicate in place
* **Alt + Drag** with Move Tool – duplicates and moves
* **Ctrl+W** – duplicate (same as Ctrl+D)

Duplicating maintains all properties (material, scale, etc.) – a huge time saver.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## End Is Your Friend

After placing any object, press **End** to instantly drop it onto the ground below. No more floating chairs!
